Preview notice · 13 October 2026

What this site processes

The product demo contains synthetic records only. Your review actions may be retained in session storage in this browser tab so you can move between demo pages. Resetting the demo removes that synthetic progress.

Inquiry forms

The forms validate and preview what you enter. They do not send or store your email, company, name, or question. An optional download creates a file on your device; clear the fields when finished.

Optional interaction diagnostics

Diagnostics are off unless you opt in through Privacy choices. An allowlisted event log stays in browser session storage and is not transmitted. No email, company name, raw case data, financial record, or free-text field goes into that log. You can clear it at any time.

Hosting and external references

This website is hosted on Sites as a public concept preview. The hosting service handles requests under its own policies. Official-source links open third-party pages; their privacy practices apply there. Fonts, original artwork, and product assets are served with this website rather than fetched from font or tracking CDNs.

Before live collection

A future inquiry service needs an identified operator, processors, retention period, consent records, unsubscribe mechanism, and working deletion contact. None is claimed to be active in this preview.

Your controls

Use Privacy choices to switch off and clear diagnostics. Use Reset demo to erase synthetic progress. Clear inquiry fields or close the page; the forms have no stored inquiry record to delete. The contact page’s privacy topic is an inquiry preview until a live operator route is configured.
